units.rawText: Faced with the massive iron fist, Erwin can't respond in time. Only by acting on sheer instinct is he able to heed Evelyn's instructions and roll to the side.
units.displayText: Faced with the massive iron fist, Erwin can't respond in time. Only by acting on sheer instinct is he able to heed Evelyn's instructions and roll to the side.

spans.text: Faced with the massive iron fist, Erwin can't respond in time. Only by acting on sheer instinct is he able to heed Evelyn's instructions and roll to the side.

units.rawText: Tsk, too late...
units.displayText: Tsk, too late...

spans.text: Tsk, too late...

units.rawText: Erwin can't get out of the Balmung's attack range in time. That much is obvious to everyone.
units.displayText: Erwin can't get out of the Balmung's attack range in time. That much is obvious to everyone.

spans.text: Erwin can't get out of the Balmung's attack range in time. That much is obvious to everyone.

units.rawText: That's when Evelyn charges in with superhuman speed, raising her shield in front of Erwin.
units.displayText: That's when Evelyn charges in with superhuman speed, raising her shield in front of Erwin.

spans.text: That's when Evelyn charges in with superhuman speed, raising her shield in front of Erwin.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: ...Hng!
units.displayText: ...Hng!

spans.text: ...Hng!

units.rawText: Evelyn is literally pounded into the ground. She tries to get up, but the side of her body that's holding her shield refuses to move.
units.displayText: Evelyn is literally pounded into the ground. She tries to get up, but the side of her body that's holding her shield refuses to move.

spans.text: Evelyn is literally pounded into the ground. She tries to get up, but the side of her body that's holding her shield refuses to move.

units.rawText: EVELYN!
units.displayText: EVELYN!

spans.text: EVELYN!

units.rawText: Before the Balmung can attack again, Erwin hurries over to Evelyn's side and drags her into the nearby vegetation.
units.displayText: Before the Balmung can attack again, Erwin hurries over to Evelyn's side and drags her into the nearby vegetation.

spans.text: Before the Balmung can attack again, Erwin hurries over to Evelyn's side and drags her into the nearby vegetation.

units.rawText: Evelyn! Are you alright? Can you hear me?
units.displayText: Evelyn! Are you alright? Can you hear me?

spans.text: Evelyn! Are you alright? Can you hear me?

units.rawText: The instructor's heading over right now! Those bastards broke the rules!
units.displayText: The instructor's heading over right now! Those bastards broke the rules!

spans.text: The instructor's heading over right now! Those bastards broke the rules!

units.rawText: We can't... let the instructor... step in... We'll lose...
units.displayText: We can't... let the instructor... step in... We'll lose...

spans.text: We can't... let the instructor... step in... We'll lose...

units.rawText: But...!
units.displayText: But...!

spans.text: But...!

units.rawText: Time to... bring out those widgets we prepared!
units.displayText: Time to... bring out those widgets we prepared!

spans.text: Time to... bring out those widgets we prepared!

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily) Ptoo!
units.displayText: (Coughs heavily) Ptoo!

spans.text: (Coughs heavily) Ptoo!

units.rawText: Evelyn raises her arm and pounds her chest heavily. The clanking mechanical noise coming from her body gradually ceases.
units.displayText: Evelyn raises her arm and pounds her chest heavily. The clanking mechanical noise coming from her body gradually ceases.

spans.text: Evelyn raises her arm and pounds her chest heavily. The clanking mechanical noise coming from her body gradually ceases.

units.rawText: Go with Plan C.
units.displayText: Go with Plan C.

spans.text: Go with Plan C.

units.rawText: Are you alright?
units.displayText: Are you alright?

spans.text: Are you alright?

units.rawText: I've activated emergency measures, no need to worry about me. Use Plan C. We can't let the instructor intervene.
units.displayText: I've activated emergency measures, no need to worry about me. Use Plan C. We can't let the instructor intervene.

spans.text: I've activated emergency measures, no need to worry about me. Use Plan C. We can't let the instructor intervene.

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Erwin steps out of the vegetation and starts giving orders. Part of the troops fall back, while the others rush toward the Balmung.
units.displayText: Erwin steps out of the vegetation and starts giving orders. Part of the troops fall back, while the others rush toward the Balmung.

spans.text: Erwin steps out of the vegetation and starts giving orders. Part of the troops fall back, while the others rush toward the Balmung.

units.rawText: Up and at 'em!
units.displayText: Up and at 'em!

spans.text: Up and at 'em!

units.rawText: Several peculiar-looking bombs are thrown at the Balmung. The SRA troopers around it couldn't stop them in time.
units.displayText: Several peculiar-looking bombs are thrown at the Balmung. The SRA troopers around it couldn't stop them in time.

spans.text: Several peculiar-looking bombs are thrown at the Balmung. The SRA troopers around it couldn't stop them in time.

units.rawText: Holy Christ! Those are EMPs! Are those tin men trying to get themselves killed? They'll get caught in the blast radius too!
units.displayText: Holy Christ! Those are EMPs! Are those tin men trying to get themselves killed? They'll get caught in the blast radius too!

spans.text: Holy Christ! Those are EMPs! Are those tin men trying to get themselves killed? They'll get caught in the blast radius too!

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: A blinding light flashes past. The Balmung comes to an abrupt halt, and the SRA troopers watch in fear as it suddenly keels over.
units.displayText: A blinding light flashes past. The Balmung comes to an abrupt halt, and the SRA troopers watch in fear as it suddenly keels over.

spans.text: A blinding light flashes past. The Balmung comes to an abrupt halt, and the SRA troopers watch in fear as it suddenly keels over.

units.rawText: The Dolls who rushed it go down along with it.
units.displayText: The Dolls who rushed it go down along with it.

spans.text: The Dolls who rushed it go down along with it.

units.rawText: You're dead!
units.displayText: You're dead!

spans.text: You're dead!

units.rawText: Out of my way!
units.displayText: Out of my way!

spans.text: Out of my way!

units.rawText: Just then, over a dozen human soldiers spring out of the bushes. Some of them rush to form a defense line, while others move with practiced skill to drag the immobilized Dolls away.
units.displayText: Just then, over a dozen human soldiers spring out of the bushes. Some of them rush to form a defense line, while others move with practiced skill to drag the immobilized Dolls away.

spans.text: Just then, over a dozen human soldiers spring out of the bushes. Some of them rush to form a defense line, while others move with practiced skill to drag the immobilized Dolls away.

units.rawText: Before the SRA troopers can react, the Dolls who fell back earlier immediately charge in again, and under Erwin's leadership, they take turns to fill the gaps in the defense line.
units.displayText: Before the SRA troopers can react, the Dolls who fell back earlier immediately charge in again, and under Erwin's leadership, they take turns to fill the gaps in the defense line.

spans.text: Before the SRA troopers can react, the Dolls who fell back earlier immediately charge in again, and under Erwin's leadership, they take turns to fill the gaps in the defense line.

units.rawText: <size=40>You're the ones who are going to die, morons!</size>
